name: Papa Parse

name: SheetJS Community Edition

name: GeoTIFF.js
summary: JavaScript GeoTIFF reader used for local raster metadata and downsampled visualization. Preview stretch is not a scientific data export.

name: FITS.js (astrojs)

name: js-yaml
summary: YAML parser and serializer used for local YAML ↔ JSON transformations; use safe parsing and do not trust arbitrary documents as executable code.
license: MIT

name: fflate
summary: Fast in-browser ZIP and GZIP utilities used for archive entry previews, selected-file extraction, decompression and ZIP packaging within the browser safety limit.

name: <model-viewer>
summary: Web component for in-browser GLB/glTF viewing with orbit controls. Multi-file glTF assets may need referenced buffers/textures; this is not a CAD/STL renderer.

name: netcdfjs
summary: Browser JavaScript reader for NetCDF classic and 64-bit-offset files; exposes dimensions, global attributes, variables and selected data values. NetCDF-4/HDF5 containers require an HDF5 reader.
license: MIT

name: h5wasm
summary: WebAssembly-powered HDF5 reader/writer. SPACE uses its read-only API to enumerate HDF5 / NetCDF-4 / NeXus groups and dataset shapes and sample small datasets; some compression plugins and datatypes may not be supported.
license: NIST-developed software; retain the full LICENSE.txt notice and verify any linked HDF5 components

name: hyparquet
summary: Dependency-free JavaScript Parquet reader with metadata/schema access and bounded row sampling, including GeoParquet geometries. Browser preview is capped and is not a full analytical engine.

name: Three.js loaders / exporters
summary: WebGL toolkit with open-source loaders for STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF, COLLADA/DAE, 3DS and VRML, plus STL/OBJ exporters. SPACE offers interactive mesh viewing and mesh conversion; unit scale, tolerances, external textures and engineering fidelity require separate validation.

name: GeoJSON viewer
summary: Native local coordinate/feature preview with a lightweight extent sketch, geometry summary and feature-property export to CSV. Projection, topology and coordinate-reference correctness are not validated.

name: OpenCascade / occt-import-js
summary: WebAssembly interface to OpenCascade for importing BREP, STEP and IGES and triangulating surfaces for display in Three.js. Mesh preview exports are not exact CAD geometry and omit parametric features / constraints / PMI.
license: LGPL-2.1 for occt-import-js package; retain license notice and review linked OpenCascade components before redistribution

name: Shapefile.js (shpjs)
summary: Reads a local ZIP archive containing shapefile components and turns features into GeoJSON for a local extent preview, property listing and GeoJSON/CSV export. CRS and topology must be checked separately.
license: MIT

name: sql.js
summary: SQLite compiled to WebAssembly for in-browser database inspection. SPACE opens the local database in memory, lists tables/views and runs a single SELECT-only query for CSV/TSV/JSON/XLSX export.

name: SheetJS bz2
